audit_name: Module 3 Representation Drift and Non-Monotonicity Audit
scope: Audit cosine similarity and Euclidean drift of degraded representations relative to 12-lead baseline
checks_performed: Pairwise 7x7 similarity matrix, cohort-stratified drift, disease-stratified drift, lead configuration ranking
passed_checks: Drift metrics mathematically validated; revealed non-monotonic inversion where 4-lead exceeds 6-lead
failed_checks_and_defects: None (structural feature of horizontal precordial plane elimination in 6-lead vs septal V1 retention in 4-lead)
unresolved_issues: Representation drift quantifies vector distance; does not prove downstream diagnostic failure by itself
supported_conclusions: Retaining V1 in 4-lead preserves higher latent representation similarity to 12-lead than keeping 6 limb leads
unsupported_conclusions: Cannot conclude causal clinical reasoning grounding from representation similarity alone
